symptom: PC cannot communicate with another network.
show_outputs: ipconfig shows IPv4 Address 192.168.10.2, Subnet Mask 255.255.255.0, Default Gateway 192.168.20.1.

expected_output.evidence: The PC is using the 192.168.10.0/24 network, while the configured gateway 192.168.20.1 belongs to a different network.
fix_steps: Set the PC default gateway to the correct router interface address.
Ping the router to confirm connectivity.
